name: get_job
description: The whole job as JSON (machine, tools, stock, operations) plus the current check results. The per-turn job state already has a summary; call this for exact values.

name: set_stock
description: Set the raw stock (a bar on the lathe, a block on the mill) and/or the workpiece material. The material sets speeds, feeds and depth per pass for every operation.

stock.description: The raw stock (leave out to change only the material)

workMaterial.description: Workpiece material class: sets speeds, feeds and depth per pass

material.description: The grade or notes as the user said it, e.g. "6082", "C45", "POM"

notes.description: How the work is held and what to remember at the machine, as the user said it; printed on the setup sheet

name: add_operation
description: Add an operation. Lathe: lathe_face, lathe_turn, lathe_profile (a whole outline with chamfers and radii, from points or from an imported side-view drawing, roughed and finished with nose radius compensation), lathe_chamfer, lathe_groove, lathe_bore (boring bar, in a drilled hole), lathe_thread (G33 passes, external or internal), lathe_partoff, lathe_drill (all sizes are diameters, Z0 = finished face, negative Z towards the chuck). Mill: mill_face, mill_pocket_rect, mill_pocket_circle, mill_contour_rect, mill_contour and mill_pocket (an imported drawing, by shape id), mill_drill, mill_slot (between two points, as wide as the tool or wider), mill_spot (a pointed cutter marks hole positions; a spot a little wider than the hole leaves it chamfered), mill_chamfer (along an edge: a shape, a rectangle or a circle; needs a chamfer tool with its angle), mill_engrave (a line of text in a single-line font), mill_thread (thread milling with a single-form thread mill, internal in a drilled hole or external on a boss) (X0 Y0 = stock front-left corner, Z0 = top after facing). Speeds and feeds come from the tool table unless you override rpm/feed. Answers with the check results.

name: update_operation
description: Change fields of an operation (e.g. {"diameter": 19.8} or {"stepDown": 1.5}).

changes.description: Fields to change; null removes an optional field. The type cannot change.

name: move_operation
description: Reorder: move an operation before another one, or to the end.

before.description: Move before this id (default: to the end)

name: set_tool
description: Add a tool to the tool table or replace one. Only when the user describes a tool they have; never invent tools silently.

tool.description: Adds the tool, or replaces the one with the same number

name: place_shape
description: Move an imported drawing on the stock: its extents' lower-left corner goes to (x, y).

x.description: X of the drawing's left edge on the stock

y.description: Y of the drawing's bottom edge on the stock

name: get_gcode
description: The generated G-code (one operation, or the start of the program). Refused while the job has errors (check or G-code lint): the answer is then the errors, not G-code.

name: add_setup
description: Mill: add another clamping of the same part after the setup in hand, with the block turned, and take it in hand (stock, operations, clamps and notes are then that setup's; tools, material and drawings are shared). Use it when a feature is on a face the tool cannot reach from above. The new stock is what the setup in hand leaves, lying the new way, with X0 Y0 at its front-left corner and Z0 on its top; the result says where the corners and the old top went, so positions can be carried over without mirroring them.

turn.description: How the block is turned from the setup in hand: over-y (flipped over left to right, the front stays the front), over-x (flipped over front to back), front-up / back-up / left-up / right-up (that face of the block as it lies now comes on top), quarter (a quarter turn counter-clockwise on the table), none

name.description: What the setup is for, e.g. "Side holes"

name: switch_setup
description: Take another setup of the job in hand (see the setups line in the job state).

setup.description: Its number in the order, from 1

name: ask_user
description: Ask the user one question with 2–5 concrete options when a decision has a real trade-off you cannot settle yourself (e.g. which tool, material unknown and it matters). Ends your turn.
